blocks.text: Savouge continued its late surge, sweeping AEP-Cabstars, 25-20, 25-23, 25-17, to clinch a semifinal berth and extend its winning streak to six games in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
